mission.title: Location Data
mission.description: Raid the computer center of Anome's hacker, Maxson, and recover his data.

npc.say: No, no, don't thank me; I just have your career advancement at heart.
Donde esta el cuarto de bano?

phase.briefing:
Oh, he's so tiresome... No, no, not you, {player}.
Well, yes, you too. But I was referring initially to the Effectuator. He's making excuses again about not being able to track Niobe because of interference from one of Anome's hackers or other. And I don't care to hear about mysterious code-corrupted goons! I'm tired of his excuses, and I want you to go...facilitate his efforts somewhat. Understood?

enter.say: Do we have to talk to him? Can't we just tell Flood we told him to shape up or else? Who's to know?

talk.say:
Aw, Floodsie-wudsie's all worried about me? I'm touched, I really am.
So look, this Maxson guy working for Anome... Operatives recovered some data pointing to what we think is one of his computer centers. My plan is that you bust in there, and, you know, kick butt and get clues and stuff. Can-do?

done.say: Okay, that's enough. No need to talk to him any more, just head outside.

phase.briefing: I don't care about excuses, operative; I just want to know when the Effectuator has found that blasted Niobe. Is that clear?

enter.say: Maxson's supposed computer center is in there. If this guy's working for Anome, then I think we know who to expect...

objective.text: Get the encoded file from the computer

done.say:
That looks like it could be useful data...but it seems to be only half of an encoded file. You'd better check around there to see if they have the other half of the file, too.
Ooh, looks like you just got more company!

objective.text: Get the other half of the file from the Unlimit Reactor

done.say:
That's it! I'll need you to upload those to me at a hardline.
Hey, I just picked up more corrupt code signals in there. Be careful!

objective.text: Upload the first half of the file at a hardline
Upload the other half of the file at a hardline

phase.briefing: Hm, more data. It seems to indicate a certain location. And I suppose I should be impressed? Have you found this person who's making even more of a laughingstock of the Effectuator than usual? Hm?

enter.say: That's the spot. Not much on the scope, though, aside from a little network activity.
A hardline junction box? That's funny. Hey, and a computer. See what's on it.

done.say:
Someone's re-routing the data feed from that hardline junction box--and it's got to be our buddy Maxson. What's he up to?
I think I can track that address. Head outside.

phase.briefing:
A hardline junction box? What am I, the phone company? Call someone who cares.
And if you need something to do in the meantime, how about--oh, I don't know--finding that hacker?

enter.say: Corrupt code readings in there... The place is hot...

done.say: Nothing doing... I have a feeling they cleared out quick. Maybe one of the goons there stuffed something in their pockets?

objective.text: Get the location data from the Unlimit Reactor

done.say:
Ooh, looks like location data... Multiple zones...
Get that uploaded to me at a hardline, stat!

objective.text: Upload the location data at a hardline

mission.finish:
A list of locations? I suppose this is what you call tangible results? At least it beats last time, when you only came up with his name.
Yes, congratulations, {player}. My expectations for you are so low that the slightest improvement over your previous miserable failings passes for a positive accomplishment.
We'll just see about these locations of yours...
